gen-fs-pramukh-rounded-roboto-slab: Pramukh Rounded packs its large, friendly lowercase tightly together, with bowls tipped open and barely a gap between glyphs. Roboto Slab keeps paragraphs steady and structured.
gen-audiowide-rubik: Futuristic and tile-like, Audiowide holds one stroke weight throughout. Rubik gives it a soft, rounded partner whose big lowercase stays easy to follow across a whole page of text.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-lexend-tera: Lexend Tera reads like a plotter pen at work, with open curves and letters spaced like stepping stones. And Tektur, expressive with its pipe-cleaner strokes and outsized lowercase, gives that tidy line something to push against.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-lexend-zetta: Tube-bright and splay-ended, Tilt Neon hits hard. Lexend Zetta spreads its tall-bodied, ribbon-thin letters wide, so a long stretch of text moves slowly and approachably, like a plain sans taking its time.
gen-irish-grover-gf-montserrat-alternate: Playful and sturdy, Irish Grover stacks big lowercase with softly varied strokes. Montserrat Alternates follows with thin, uniform lines and a crowded-up lowercase, so paragraphs read in a smooth, contemporary thread.
gen-eater-rubik: Dark, jagged and a bit menacing, Eater spaces its letters wide with moderate stroke contrast. Rubik takes over below with soft, rounded sans letters, and long paragraphs stay friendly and clear.
gen-flavors-inter: Flavors towers with a stubby, pencil-like x-height and diagonals as heavy as its stems. Yet Inter lets paragraphs breathe, its big counters and tube-smooth lines carrying a long read without fuss.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-lexend-mega: Drawn as if with one nib, Lexend Mega has a body height nearly matching its capitals and clear gaps in every c. Oxanium, tall in the lowercase and single-stroke throughout, adds a commanding top note.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-lexend-giga: Paprika scatters its letters apart while lowercase fills the line like capitals. Yet Lexend Giga, flat and single-weight with generous tracking, gives it a modern, orderly partner.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-lexend-exa: Revalia's open-curved g sits in a tall band of widely spaced letters with short stalks above, giving headings a relaxed stride. Lexend Exa follows like a single thread, steady from line to line.
